text: The Tripartite Agreement (TPA) in Bangladesh is a public-private partnership initiative aimed at developing a parametric cyclone insurance solution to address climate and disaster risks. It is part of a global effort under the InsuResilience Vision 2025 to expand risk finance and insurance for climate-vulnerable countries. The program focuses on capacity-building for inclusive insurance and risk finance across sectors like agriculture and public financial management, with a flagship product targeting cyclone risk.
